$comment: Template for ONE project. Only id and title are required. Every other field is optional: delete it, leave it empty ("" or []) or set it to null and that part of the pop-up simply isn't shown. Dates are "YYYY-MM".
title: REQUIRED — project name
tagline: One sentence under the title. If missing, `summary` is used instead.
summary: Short description (1–2 sentences) used on cards and as the tagline fallback.
experienceId: id from experience.json (e.g. "ieec") — or null if it's independent
lane: "projects" (appears above its work box on the timeline) or "venture" (own bar, like BitSpace)
role: Your role, e.g. "Sole developer" or "Hardware & firmware lead"
context: Where/with whom, e.g. "IEEC research team" or "Hackathon team of 4"
overview: Paragraph 2 (add as many as you want).

media.src: path or URL to the image
media.alt: What the image shows (for screen readers)
media.caption: Optional caption shown under the media
media.fit: optional — "contain" (show whole image) or "cover" (fill the frame, may crop). Leave out for automatic.
media.focus: optional — which part to keep when cropped with cover, e.g. "center", "top", "30% 50%"

media.src: path or URL to an .mp4/.webm file (only if you host the file yourself)
media.poster: optional still image shown before playing
media.caption: Optional caption

links.label: Source code
links.type: code | demo | paper | website | video | other
